audit_scope: Offline accounting, deterministic provider-state replay and integrity checks. No new inference and no semantic source adjudication.

integrity.privacy_check: Initial states equal the explicit whitelist; routing/focus requests reconstruct exactly from initial state, validated shared-scan hints and actually inspected frozen cards. Unopened bodies and coordinator fields are excluded. Captured runtime timezone is omitted initially and may appear only as inspected source.
integrity.code_verification_basis: Captured implementation and both imported dependencies matched frozen hashes at audit time. Those exact sources are preserved in commit 6c06c6ca; later reporting fixes do not change the capture.

static_without_unused_scan.scope: The static heuristic and focused request do not consume scan signals; a static-only deployment can omit the bank scan entirely. This is an accounting subtraction, not another inference run.

invalid_response_components.interpretation: Mechanism choice violates the highest-probability rule. Preserve the exact answer; composed lead is unassessed, not a negative. Other three components remain valid.

limitations: Four curated mechanism pairs and correlated repeats are descriptive, not independent samples or evidence of population-level accuracy.
The menus contain five curated source cards each; this tests selection among available cards, not autonomous filename or repository discovery.
Necessary-card coverage is an offline diagnostic, not proof of semantic sufficiency or a claim that other evidence cannot establish the concern. It never enters provider state.
Raw high leads follow the frozen >=0.8 contract plus valid mechanism/location rule. They are not confirmed findings; an invalid composed lead is null, not false.
One static control focus has an invalid mechanism choice; its .63 contract, .62 missing-context and changed0 evidence components remain valid and preserved.
No at-threshold control leads were produced among valid composed judgments; this does not certify the controls against every possible defect.
Actual totals count shared scans once. Standalone workflows each include that scan and must not be added to estimate actual spending.
The static policy does not consume the initial scan. Static-with-shared-scan is not the cheapest static implementation; static_without_unused_scan reports the removable cost.
No no-bank routing ablation was run; the adaptive coverage gain cannot be attributed specifically to the 204-question scan.
Source-byte counts include changed and inspected source once per focused packet, repeated across case/repeat observations. They are not total request bytes or token counts.
Latency is the sum of measured request durations, excluding local preparation, file writes and other orchestration. It is not total process wall-clock time or downstream reviewer time.
The .78/.80 adaptive rounding outputs and .80/.80 static outputs used identical focused inputs; the high-band difference does not demonstrate superior evidence selection.
No downstream reviewer, token-to-first-finding or production merge-decision outcome was measured.

post_capture_reporting_correction.description: After capture, an offline regression reproduced a KeyError when summarizing a persisted started attempt without elapsed_seconds. The reporting fix sums known durations and counts unknown latency globally and per arm. Future preparation also freezes copies of the runner and two imported code dependencies.
post_capture_reporting_correction.effect_on_this_capture: None. All 80 captured attempts already have valid durations; original inputs, requests, responses, capture and summary hashes remain unchanged.
